lastCompletedStory.title: Stamp orchestrator session id on cycle-tokens events and reset the baseline at session boundaries

nextStoryContext: US-001 (CAM-333) is complete and was the only story in this PRD. CycleTokensEventDetail now carries an optional orchSessionId (src/supervisor/events.ts). recordCycleTokens (src/commands/journal.ts) stamps it via a new injectable readOrchSessionId (default reads .claude/<ORCH_SESSION_MARKER>, reusing the constant from src/tmux/session.ts). Two reset mechanisms now guard the telescoping orchTokens baseline across an orchestrator-session boundary: (a) reconstructPriorOrchCumulative resets to a fresh telescoping sum when two consecutive logged cycle-tokens events carry different orchSessionId; (b) recordCycleTokens itself zeroes priorOrchCumulative at record time when the CURRENT session id differs from the trailing logged event's orchSessionId (catches the very first post-respawn cycle, which mechanism (a) cannot see yet). Both are no-ops when the current session id is unresolvable, so all pre-existing (no orchSessionId) tests/behavior are byte-for-byte unchanged. A shared parseCycleTokensDetail helper was extracted to keep reconstructPriorOrchCumulative under Biome's cognitive-complexity ceiling (15). src/supervisor/events.ts file-size ceiling was raised 786->793 in scripts/file-size-budget.json (staged with a dated _ref note citing CAM-333) to accommodate the new field + doc comment.
